verdict.rationale: Lever's own Automation Hub is described as handling routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing candidates, and Advanced Nurture follows up with candidates automatically, so the product does ship background automations. The evidence is brief marketing copy only, with no documentation of how users configure them. Missing for 10: documentation of how users set up and configure automations (triggers, conditions, schedules), evidence they run unattended over time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Lever's Automation Hub handles routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing, and advancing candidates.
